cohort: Singleton infants born from frozen-thawed embryo transfer cycles, categorized into a natural cycle (n=8132) group and a hormone replacement therapy (n=4975) group.
finding: In the HRT group, both thinner (<8.0 mm) and thicker (>=12.0 mm) endometria were associated with an increased risk of SGA and an inverted U-shaped relationship with birthweight, while no significant association was found in the NC group.
birth_weight: N/A (measured as an outcome for all singletons)
gest_age: N/A (used to classify SGA/LGA outcomes for all singletons)
